name: create_kotlin_csv_leaderboard
description: Builds a CSV leaderboard (top-3 by score desc, tie-break by name) consumed by an existing printer
prompts: An existing src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/LeaderboardPrinter.kt calls ScoreBoard.topThree(csv), but ScoreBoard does not exist yet. Create src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/ScoreBoard.kt (package com.optarena.app) defining object ScoreBoard with fun topThree(csv: String): List<Pair<String, Int>>. Parse CSV text whose first line is the header `name,score` and return the top three entries as (name, score) pairs ordered by score DESCENDING, breaking ties by name ASCENDING. Skip any data row whose name is blank/whitespace or whose score is not a valid integer. If fewer than three valid rows exist, return all of them (still sorted). Header-only or empty input returns an empty list. Do not modify LeaderboardPrinter.kt.
